The Real Challenges

Running a Business Is Hard.
It Does Not Have to Be Chaotic.

Most small business owners lose money not because business is slow, but because they cannot see what is actually happening. TRAXXO fixes that.

"I don't know what's left in stock."

Selling items you don't have, or sitting on dead stock, both cost you money. Manual counting is slow, inaccurate and exhausting.

TRAXXO tracks every item automatically

"I don't know if I'm actually making profit."

Sales feel good but expenses pile up. Without clear numbers, you are guessing, and guessing with your business is dangerous.

See profit clearly with TRAXXO Reports

"My customers owe me, but I forget who."

Credit given without records is money lost. When customers owe you and you cannot prove it, you cannot collect it.

Full credit history for every customer

"I have no proper record of my sales."

Paper receipts get lost. Notebooks are messy. If you cannot see your sales history, you cannot grow from it.

Every sale logged, receipts printed instantly

"I'm scared of losing all my data."

One phone lost, one crash, and years of records are gone. That fear should not follow a business owner around.

Automatic cloud backup. Always safe.

"I can't trust my staff with my business."

With no system, it is impossible to know what is happening when you are not there. Accountability starts with visibility.

Staff PINs, roles and activity logs (Pro)
What's Inside

Everything Your Business Needs.
Nothing It Does Not.

Each module works together so that a sale updates stock, an expense hits your reports, and your books stay accurate automatically.

Inventory

Track every product, quantity and value in real time. Get alerted when stock runs low so you never miss a sale.

Sales

Record sales instantly, apply discounts and see your revenue grow. Every transaction is logged and searchable.

Expenses

Log business expenses by category and see exactly where your money is going: rent, supplies, staff, logistics.

Customers

Build a database of your customers, track their purchase history and manage credit accounts with confidence.

Credit Management

Know who owes you, how much and since when. Record payments and maintain a complete credit history with every customer.

Reports

See your business at a glance: daily summaries, profit and loss, top products and expenses. Data you can act on.

Receipt Printing

Generate and print professional receipts for every sale. Your customers get proof; you keep complete records.

Cloud Backup

Your data is automatically backed up to the cloud. Lose your phone, get a new one: your business comes back with you.

Device Sync

Use TRAXXO on multiple devices and everything stays in sync. Perfect for businesses with more than one point of sale.
